study type: Longitudinal cohort study (secondary outcome of a randomised clinical trial)
exposure: Time after birth (8 weeks after discharge, 6 months, 12 months postpartum)
Gestational age (very preterm vs other preterm)
outcome: Parental stress (measured by Swedish Parenting Stress Questionnaire)
cohort: The study included 493 mothers and 329 fathers of 547 preterm infants in Sweden.
finding: Mothers experienced more role restriction and fathers more social isolation, with stress decreasing in mothers but increasing in fathers between 6 and 12 months, and higher stress reported by mothers of very preterm infants, parents of twins, and parents with lower perceived general health.
